distribution_model.detail: Operates its own pawn stores that make loans and sell pre-owned merchandise.

market_position.detail: Quality used goods at budget-friendly prices for budget-conscious shoppers.

notes: Pawn loan revenue is financial services, but retail resale of pre-owned goods fits the sector.

product_category.detail: Pre-owned jewelry, electronics, tools, instruments, sporting goods; pawn loans secured by items.

purchase_frequency.detail: Customers visit for occasional cash needs and opportunistic purchases of used goods.

sub_sector.value: pawn loans; pre-owned goods resale retail
